acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-015 valid monad.toml becomes a deterministic semantic document record.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Semantic config parser tests establish stable TOML source/document identity, exact content hash and byte length, deterministic canonical path, and repeatable serialized output.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-016 schema/parse errors remain diagnostics and block a valid semantic config document.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Malformed TOML, duplicate keys, unknown keys, unsupported schema versions, invalid UTF-8, and stale effective state fail closed through structured diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-017 normalized semantic representation is deterministic and retains source/effective-value provenance distinctions.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Canonical file/default values remain distinct from CLI-effective values; ordered maps and serialization are deterministic.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: .monad/manifest.yaml cannot override or become a competing semantic config source.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Legacy-manifest non-authority regression passes and serialized semantic state contains no manifest authority.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No environment interpolation, command substitution, network lookup, or include execution occurs.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Executable-looking and interpolation/include/network-like strings remain inert parser data in regression coverage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Effective configuration is bound to the exact source bytes identified by the semantic document.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Rebound validation rejects stale or unrelated effective configuration for different monad.toml bytes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Reliable TOML source ranges are retained for downstream diagnostics and provenance explanations.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Spanned TOML values are retained as deterministic semantic-path to byte-range mappings and verified against exact source slices.

risks: The CLI-provenance rebinding helper must be intentionally extended if future bootstrap-supported CLI override fields are added.
agent_result.summary: Implemented the bounded semantic adapter for canonical monad.toml in monad-core, including deterministic source/document identity, canonical versus CLI-effective provenance, fail-closed invalid-input diagnostics, legacy-manifest non-authority, inert configuration text, exact-byte/effective-state binding, and retained reliable TOML byte ranges.

validation.summary: Formatting check passed on the clean EXEC-0010 lineage.
All 131 monad-core tests passed, including exact-byte provenance and TOML source-range regressions.
Scoped strict Clippy passed; only the explicitly excluded pre-existing unrelated large-enum lint is exempted.
Trace and deterministic machine projections are synchronized on the clean execution lineage.
Baseline-to-result diff contains only five monad-core source files and eight machine projections; no .eos or governed artifact path is present.
